description: IMF SDMX Central is the International Monetary Fund's online SDMX registry, powered by Fusion Metadata Registry version 11.24.0. It publishes SDMX structural metadata, such as data structure definitions, dataflows, codelists, concept schemes, category schemes, hierarchies, VTL rulesets and structure maps, lists organisations, agencies and data providers, and offers tools to verify and convert datasets between formats and data structure definitions, to generate Excel reporting templates with pre-filled data, and to export structures through a web service. It is run by the International Monetary Fund. Coverage is global, for the statistical domains that countries report to the IMF. The registry and conversion tools are available free online, with some functions behind a login; the page read gives no licence. Caveats: it holds structures and tools, not the IMF's data series themselves, and using it well needs SDMX knowledge. For simulation it helps build pipelines that read and validate IMF-style financial and economic data automatically for resilience models. It is related to the SDMx standard record in this catalogue.
